description: Scrape upcoming events by city, artist profiles, or venue profiles from Resident Advisor (ra.co).

artistName.description: Artist slug or name for artist profile (mode=artistProfile). Example: aphex-twin, bicep, peggy-gou.
artistName.title: Artist name / slug

city.description: City name for event search (mode=eventsByCity). Examples: london, berlin, new-york, amsterdam, paris.
city.title: City

countryCode.description: Country for event search (mode=eventsByCity). Two-letter code.
countryCode.title: Country code

dateFrom.description: Fetch events from this date onwards. Defaults to today if empty. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
dateFrom.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: Fetch events up to this date. Leave empty for no upper bound. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
dateTo.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to scrape from Resident Advisor.
enumTitles: Events by city — upcoming events for a city
Artist profile — artist info + upcoming events
Venue profile — club/venue info + recent events
mode.title: Mode

venueSlug.description: Venue slug or name for venue profile (mode=venueProfile). Example: fabric, berghain, panorama-bar.
venueSlug.title: Venue slug or search term

title: Resident Advisor (RA) Scraper Input
